title: What If Earth Shrank Into a Black Hole?

scenes.text: What if Earth shrank into a black hole? It would be roughly the size of a marble.
You would squeeze all of Earth's mass inside a radius of about nine millimeters.
From far away, its gravity would match Earth's today, because gravity depends on mass, not size.
So the Moon would keep orbiting right where it is, pulled by the very same gravity.
But the ground, the air and the oceans would all be gone. Only a tiny dark dot would remain.
The Sun works the same way. Squeeze it to a radius of just 2.95 kilometers, and the planets would circle on as before.
